semantics.group_inheritance: Expand names into separate records; defaults[name], targets[name], required_by_name[name] override group fields. A service omitted from consumers has no runtime consumer. Overrides are explicit service-specific classifications; unsupported_consumers[service] lists read-but-ineffective settings.
semantics.absent_consumer: Absent: setting has no effect; unset and empty both ignored. No runtime default or requirement.

semantics.paths: Evidence paths are repository-relative; SD means dotnet/src/TaxCredit.ServiceDefaults/Hosting, OR means dotnet/src/TaxCredit.Orchestrator/Hosting, GW means dotnet/src/TaxCredit.Gateway.
